purpose: R3 evidence gate matrix for historically demonstrated INSIDE ARG operation families

prohibited_without_new_cue: alternate serial reordering chosen for attractive output
gates.note: Existing metadata supports registration, not an independently motivated alternative permutation.

gates.precedent: PC/acorn side structure constraining row order
sticker_evidence: physical sticker perimeter potentially recoverable from original photos
allowed_now: measure whether perimeter evidence is observable
record any repeated physical edge feature before interpreting it
prohibited_without_new_cue: permute rows using invented check bits
treat cropped tile-master seams as physical sticker-margin evidence

gates.precedent: Xbox geometry before Braille; CE background assembly before path
allowed_now: row/chunk and column/rail meanings with frozen rules
prospective/holdout validation of preregistered spatial rivals
prohibited_without_new_cue: free rotations/reflections chosen after output inspection
gates.note: Experiment 319 closed background-row masks absent a domain bridge; Experiment 318 left direct body row/column readings live.

sticker_evidence: slash/dot tail is a distinct 27-cell alphabet zone
allowed_now: test simple preregistered actions directly encoded by the one-of-three tail index
prohibited_without_new_cue: interpret terminal 100 as an instruction merely because it is compact
gates.note: The tail may encode an operation; the exact operation must remain independently motivated.

gates.precedent: Terminal 41 RGB values selecting later layers
gates.dependency: an exact parameter or registration rule emitted by another artifact
allowed_now: inspect independently recovered artifact content for an explicit selector/key
test an exact supplied parameter once found
prohibited_without_new_cue: use arbitrary previous ARG answers as keys
treat 534brn filename/path characters as a key without an artifact-native instruction
gates.note: The background path is an output/location, not itself an established foreground key.

allowed_now: apply exact filtering only if a sticker or linked artifact supplies the value/class before inspection
prohibited_without_new_cue: borrow 41/RGB values from unrelated solved stages

allowed_now: run a named transform only when the sticker system exposes both transform identity and required parameters

gates.precedent: E. E. Cummings text used as externally identified overlay source
allowed_now: overlay/select from a specific text or artwork only if the puzzle identifies that source
convert carrier only when a sticker-native or linked artifact cue specifies audio/image/media semantics

gates.precedent: historical website/printer endpoints consuming solved-stage inputs
sticker_evidence: no independently registered foreground consumer currently known
gates.dependency: external artifact with independently visible input grammar or matching structural fingerprint
allowed_now: bounded audit of explicitly clue-bearing artifacts under docs/external-consumer-audit.md
prohibited_without_new_cue: spray 100/XYZG/route words into URLs or endpoints
